text:
Nina Torres: FYI Novara Health (acct:novara-prod) can't finish onboarding — their APAC traffic is dropped at the edge. They requested APAC allowlist + temporary rate lift for a failover validation run tomorrow.

Owen McKay: Drop ticket and CIDRs so I can scope the change. We should prefer per-account ACL.

Nina Torres: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5122
Customer IPs: 198.51.100.64/26, 203.0.115.0/27
Requested increase: 100 rps -> 500 rps in ap-southeast-1, window 36h starting 2024-08-05 22:00 SGT.

Maya Chen: Noted. Renewal touchpoint in 5 weeks; keep this on the critical path. I'll own the enablement call during the run.

Owen McKay: Creating change now. Will scope to account-level ACL and a temporary rate override.

EdgeBot: Change request CR-3184 created. Applying per-account ACL to ap-southeast-1.

Owen McKay: Pushing config snippet:
```
edge_acl:
  account: novara-prod
  region: ap-southeast-1
  allowlist:
    - 198.51.100.64/26
    - 203.0.115.0/27
rate_limit_temp:
  old: 100
  new: 500
  hours: 36
```

Owen McKay: ETA ~4m. Observability tag: cs:novara-failover; watching p95 and 5xx. Auto-rollback on >1% 5xx sustained 3m.

CS Automation: Deployed ACL and rate override in 00:03:50. CR-3184.

Maya Chen: Nina, please confirm customer on-call and invite them to the run. I'll prepare canary prompts.

Nina Torres: Contact: Arjun Mehta <arjun@novarahealth.com>. Run starts 2024-08-05 22:00 SGT. Added to CS-5122.

EdgeBot: Rollout completed. No errors during 10m validation window. :white_check_mark:

Owen McKay: Temporary window scheduled to expire 2024-08-07T10:00:00+08:00 with auto-rollback. Routing pinned to redwood-optimized/gpt-small-quant for test.

Maya Chen: I'm on the enablement call. Request customer confirm: (1) primary endpoints return 200, (2) p95 latency, (3) any functional regressions.

Nina Torres: Customer reported initial run at 22:05 SGT. Quick check at 22:30: no 5xx, p95 ~160ms. They will provide a final verification at end of run.

EdgeBot: Monitoring shows no 5xx spike. trace=novara-failover-20240805.

Maya Chen: Good signal. Filing a doc action for a short "edge allowlist and temp-rate" playbook to attach to CS-5122.

Nina Torres: Customer confirmed successful validation at 01:10 SGT, sustained throughput at target, no errors. Marking onboarding step done.

CS Automation: Updated CS-5122: onboarding_step=egress_allowlist_apac -> done.

Owen McKay: Logged ops note CR-3184-ops: templated per-account ACL for faster future onboards.

Maya Chen: Reduced immediate renewal risk to green. Will follow up with the customer for feedback on the onboarding docs. :tada:
